UP PET 2026 Application Deadline Extended

The application deadline for the Uttar Pradesh Preliminary Eligibility Test (UP PET) 2026 was September 7th. Candidates who have passed the 10th grade were eligible to apply. The deadline was extended by the commission due to technical issues. Applicants will be able to make corrections to their applications until September 8th. Details regarding eligibility criteria, application fees, and the exam pattern were also available.
